name: MonarchEmptyState
title: EmptyState
summary: What will appear in an empty view and the action that creates it: an icon tile, a heading, a message, actions and a tip.
whenToUse: When a list, a table, a card or a screen has nothing to show yet, when a search or filter matched nothing, or when there is nothing left to do.
whenNotToUse: When content failed to load, use MonarchErrorState. While content loads, use MonarchSkeleton or MonarchProgress.
api: @Composable fun MonarchEmptyState(title: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, kind: MonarchEmptyStateKind = MonarchEmptyStateKind.FirstRun, size: MonarchEmptyStateSize = MonarchEmptyStateSize.Md, message: String? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, tip: String? = null, onClearFilters: (() -> Unit)? = null, actions: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, clearFiltersLabel: String? = null)
enum class MonarchEmptyStateKind { FirstRun, Filtered, Success }
enum class MonarchEmptyStateSize { Sm, Md, Lg }

options.name: title
options.description: What is missing. Marked as a heading.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the empty state.

options.name: kind
options.description: FirstRun, Filtered or Success: the tile color and the clear-filters button.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm, Md or Lg: spacing, tile size and type sizes. The web calls them compact, inline and page.

options.name: message
options.description: What will appear here and how to create it.

options.name: icon
options.description: An icon in a tinted tile. Hidden from TalkBack; no tile without it.

options.name: tip
options.description: A short hint under the actions, in small muted text.

options.name: onClearFilters
options.description: With kind Filtered, adds a "Clear filters" button before the actions.

options.name: actions
options.description: Buttons, laid out in a centered row that wraps.

options.name: clearFiltersLabel
options.description: Label of the clear-filters button. null uses monarch_emptystate_clear_filters.

states.name: first run
states.description: The icon tile in the accent tint.

states.name: filtered
states.description: The accent tint, and a "Clear filters" button when onClearFilters is given.

states.name: success
states.description: The icon tile in the success tint.

appearance: A centered column: an optional 40dp tile (32dp when small) in the accent subtle background with the icon in the accent strong color, or the success pair for Success; a heading in default text; a muted message; centered actions; a muted caption tip. The same roles in every theme.
platformNotes: Material 3 has no empty state, so it is built; iOS wraps ContentUnavailableView. Actions are a slot, where iOS takes up to two titles and closures. The web line layout (one row with icon, text and actions) and the children slot are not offered. Web sizes compact, inline and page are Sm, Md and Lg. The web shows a check icon for success by default; Monarch bundles no icons, so the tile appears only when the app passes an icon. The title is a heading for TalkBack; the web headingLevel has no equivalent.
accessibility: The title is marked as a heading.
The icon tile is hidden from TalkBack; the title and message carry the meaning.
Buttons keep their own roles and 48dp touch targets; the row of actions wraps at large font sizes.
Title, message and tip wrap and are not cut off at the largest font size.
edgeCases: onClearFilters is ignored unless kind is Filtered.
The empty state has no maximum width; inside a wide screen give it one with the modifier.

examples.title: First run
A filter that matched nothing
examples.code:
MonarchEmptyState(
    title = "No matching tickets",
    kind = MonarchEmptyStateKind.Filtered,
    size = MonarchEmptyStateSize.Sm,
    message = "Try another search.",
    onClearFilters = { cleared++ },
)

parityExceptions.reason: NATIVE GAP: the tip is a plain String, so the key N is not drawn as a keyboard key cap as on web.
